description: This is a Java source file defining a Swing-based graphical user interface form for application settings, specifically a class named 'SettingsForm' that extends JFrame and implements MouseListener. It handles UI components for application configuration such as colors, fonts, display options, file associations, and other user preferences.

classes.name: SettingsForm
classes.description: A Swing JFrame class providing a GUI for configuring application settings, including color schemes, font choices, display options, file associations, and other user preferences. Implements MouseListener to handle color selection dialogs and button actions.

methods.name: initComponents
methods.description: Initializes all GUI components, sets up layout, and configures tabbed panels with various settings options.

methods.name: initTabs
methods.description: Sets up individual tab panels within the settings dialog, including 'General', 'Table Display', 'Clipboard', 'Icons', and 'Scale' configurations.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events on color labels and buttons to open color chooser dialogs, apply settings, or reset to defaults.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Reads user input from GUI components and updates the 'Settings' object accordingly.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of 'ECUEditor' from 'ECUEditorManager'.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current settings state to persistent storage and refreshes UI components.

methods.name: drawVisibleTables
methods.description: Iterates over all open tables in the editor and instructs them to redraw, ensuring UI updates after settings change.
